payload.name: Intermittent motion planning for harvesting robots
payload.fact: An intermittent motion planning model using deep reinforcement learning for a dual-arm harvesting robot reduced vehicle parking frequency by 46.5% and 36.1% and decreased arm idleness by 42.9% and 33.9% compared to grid-based and area division algorithms.
payload.boundary: Dual-arm tomato harvesting robot in greenhouse
